ITEM 1 | Scrambled egg mass, bright yellow with mixed paler and deeper golden patches, soft, fluffy curds with irregular clumped edges, slightly moist with a faint sheen, covering roughly the upper-right third of a white square plate (about 12 x 9 cm footprint), piled about 2 cm high, sits directly on the plate beside the potato pieces | 150

ITEM 2 | Pan-fried potato chunks, six irregular cubed pieces about 2-3 cm each, golden-brown to dark brown exterior with crisp-looking browned and slightly charred edges, pale cream interior visible on cut faces, dry surface with no visible glaze, clustered in the lower-left of the plate next to the scrambled egg | 110

ITEM 3 | Thin pale yellow oily residue, a small smear with slight sheen pooled at the lower edge of the scrambled egg mass, about 3 x 2 cm, barely visible on the white plate | 5
